messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["lion", "bird"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large bipedal creature with the body of a lioness standing reared upright on its two hind legs in side view facing right, with tawny lion fur, a lioness head, muscular hind legs ending in clawed paws, and a long slender tail with a dark tuft dragging behind, and with two very large outspread feathered bird-like wings extending from its shoulders and back.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "a lioness head with tawny fur, amber eyes, dark nose, and whiskered muzzle", "part": "head", "where": "at the top front of the body, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded lion ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the top sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "short tawny lion fur with paler fur on the chest and underbelly", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the head, torso and legs"}, {"looks_like": "muscular tawny lion hind legs", "part": "legs", "where": "at the lower rear and middle of the body supporting the body upright"}, {"looks_like": "large lion paws with short claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "a long slender lion tail with tawny fur and a dark bushy tuft at the tip", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear of the body down and behind to the ground"}, {"looks_like": "very large broad bird wings", "part": "wings", "where": "extending outward from the shoulder and back area on the left and right sides"}, {"looks_like": "layered brown, tan and gray bird feathers with long flight feathers at the trailing edges", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the entire surface of both wings"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
